map.基于神经传导速度(NCS)和肌电图(EMG)检查结果，辅助定位周围神经病变部位及: Based on nerve conduction study (NCS) and electromyography (EMG) findings, helps localize peripheral nerve lesion site and pathology type
map.F波潜伏期延长或消失: F wave latency prolonged or absent
map.5. 运动神经传导 — 传导阻滞/时间离散: 5. Motor nerve conduction - conduction block / temporal dispersion
map.有传导阻滞或时间离散增加: Conduction block or increased temporal dispersion
map.轴索损害：波幅降低为主，CV正常或轻度减慢（≥80%正常值），SNAP降低: Axonal: mainly amplitude reduction, CV normal or mildly slowed (>=80% normal), SNAP reduced
map.脱髓鞘：CV明显减慢（＜80%正常值），远端潜伏期延长，F波异常，可见传导阻滞: Demyelinating: CV markedly slowed (<80% normal), distal latency prolonged, F wave abnormal, conduction block may be seen
map.SNAP降低：病变在背根神经节(DRG)远端（周围神经病变）: SNAP reduced: lesion distal to dorsal root ganglion (DRG), i.e. peripheral neuropathy
map.SNAP正常+感觉障碍：病变在DRG近端（神经根/脊髓后索）: SNAP normal + sensory deficit: lesion proximal to DRG (nerve root / posterior spinal cord)
map.NCS/EMG是周围神经病诊断的核心检查。轴索损害常见于糖尿病性、酒精性、中毒性: NCS/EMG is the core exam for diagnosing peripheral neuropathy. Axonal damage is common in diabetic, alcoholic, toxic neuropathies; demyelination in GBS, CIDP, MMN; conduction block is characteristic of CIDP and MMN. Anterior horn cell lesions are seen in ALS/motor neuron disease. This tool is for auxiliary reference only, to be combined with clinical judgment.
map.腕管、GBS、CIDP 等定位。: Localization for carpal tunnel, GBS, CIDP, etc.
map.传导速度减慢 + 远端潜伏期延长 + 传导阻滞/ F 波异常：提示脱髓鞘性神经病: Slowed conduction + prolonged distal latency + conduction block / F wave abnormal: suggests demyelinating neuropathy (e.g. GBS/CIDP).
map.波幅降低、传导速度正常 + 纤颤电位/大 MUP：轴索型周围神经病或慢性神经源性: Reduced amplitude, normal conduction velocity + fibrillation potentials / large MUP: axonal peripheral neuropathy or chronic neurogenic damage.
map.波幅(amp)、传导速度(CV)、远端潜伏期(dlat)、F 波、阻滞及肌电自发: Amplitude (amp), conduction velocity (CV), distal latency (dlat), F wave, block and EMG spontaneous potentials / recruitment.
map.定位损害性质（脱髓鞘/轴索）与分布（近端/远端），指导病因检查。: Localize lesion nature (demyelinating/axonal) and distribution (proximal/distal), guide etiologic workup.
